name: build-ui
description: A step-by-step workflow for UI work that ends with a checked, working result. Use when asked to build a new screen, page, feature or app UI, a dashboard or admin view, or to polish, simplify or review an existing interface: read the project first, follow the plan for that kind of job, then render the result at phone and desktop sizes, fix what is wrong and check again. Works on its own; real app and website references from UXKIN are optional.
